svg.aria-label: Service discovery and a service mesh. When an instance of the payments service starts, it registers its address in a service registry such as Consul, etcd or Kubernetes DNS, and keeps sending heartbeats; dead instances drop out. The orders service looks up payments in the registry and calls a healthy instance. With a service mesh, a sidecar proxy next to each service does the lookup, load balancing, retries, timeouts, mutual TLS and metrics, so application code just calls payments.
